propositions: BindingStore embeds scattered lifecycle concerns (forward/reverse transitions, pending/confirmed state, numeric ID re-key, comment identity, absence grace, tombstones, unretire) that should be extracted into a cohesive policy owner
Production rich-text convergence mutates inner dictionaries through shallow all_bindings() bypassing future policy seams and requiring a narrow, supported mutation operation
At-most-one identity must be maintained via targeted single-key reverse pops; stale reverse entries must be cleaned only in existing permitted cases, never by guessed sweep

Comment IDs remain append-only and change-gated; legacy entries without the field must remain readable without rewrite; three confirmed 404s retire; successful reads reset absence; numeric-ID lookup re-keys instead of retiring

The narrow rich-emission operation (note_rich_emit) must preserve current hash/counter/save behavior and fail-open on missing bindings while the public facade retains all existing method signatures and shallow all_bindings() semantics
Facade must remain authoritative coordinator of lifecycle policy and repository unit-of-work; no adapter or reconciler caller receives direct writable repository access
